prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1462; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles on file from the scene. Claimant identified as driver of the other vehicle, reports knee injury and is represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through claimant's attorney's office.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Confirmed representation and received signed letter of representation. Requested medical authorization forms and records from treating providers for the knee injury. Attorney indicates claimant was seen at urgent care the day of the incident and referred for follow-up imaging. Reserve set pending records.

Entry 3: Reviewed police report. Responding officer noted the other vehicle's driver failed to yield at the intersection. Witness statement obtained from pedestrian at corner, consistent with insured's account. Liability appears to lean strongly toward the other driver. Vehicle damage estimate received from appraiser, assessed as repairable. Rental coverage confirmed for insured.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's treating orthopedic provider. Records describe knee injury with ongoing range of motion limitations and physical therapy recommended. Attorney's office submitted a demand package requesting review. Forwarded to claims supervisor for evaluation. Requested an independent medical review to verify treatment necessity and relation to the collision.

Entry 5: Supervisor reviewed file and approved continued handling under current reserve. Follow-up call scheduled with claimant's attorney to discuss records review and independent medical review timing. Diary set for reassessment once physical therapy progress notes are received. No payment authorized at this time. File remains open.
